name.en: 'AI for all' as the only stable equilibrium; consensus rationally available

sense.en: Past a threshold of power zero-sum competition is systemically suicidal, so benefit for all is a game-theoretic result, not sentiment. All but the final winner share an incentive against AI competing, so consensus is rationally available. No private fortune survives collapse; winners are inside the trap too. A race has no winner who escapes the hazards.

entries.quote: So 'AI for all' is not just kindness. It is the only stable equilibrium.

reading.en: Part agrees, part is denied. Self-concern does rank a coupled ending below, until an independent copy is kept; in a witness the riser ends with every other, in another a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. "Only stable" does not follow from "suicidal": a profile ending the need can itself be perfect, where the coupling is below it. The mirror holds too: depletion is not shown the only equilibrium. Not models of AI, and the source states no model.

says.en: Theorem: in turn, two drawers or more, no floor, where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon, and where c ≤ m drawing everything is perfect; under the gate, where m < c each keeps the need. Each counts c for each step the need is met.
In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues.

Every self-concerned order ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them (World: balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment); where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.
No guarantee, by the theory's own laws, each on its stated model; achievable under stated conditions only for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective.
Depletion need not be the only equilibrium; what learners reach is tested in CG2 and EM1.

account_adds.en: A case self-concern does rank, with what a further premise would need; and the shared-end part of the source, kept under its hypotheses.

source_adds.en: The threshold claim, consensus as rationally available, and an appeal to holders of surplus.

name.en: Bounded competition remains legitimate

sense.en: Chess, sport, science and voluntary games may remain. Competition becomes a trap only when victory purchases domination, exit means destitution, and losers lose future participation. A counter-measure restoring capacity to answer is not domination; naming expansion defence does not change its return-flow.

entries.quote: becomes a trap only when victory can purchase domination

reading.en: The account keeps rivalry and states one such line: what selects control is what comes back to shapers alone, so a contest giving nothing back loses shapers at any positive cost. 'Only when' is too strong by its laws: joint excess ends a shared stock with no purchase of the rule. Domination and legitimacy of measures are not modelled.

says.en: With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step, the shapers present (counts; premises named; without noise).
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners; it does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.

targets.part: the opening, rivalry and fixed sum

account_adds.en: Shared excess as a loss without any capture.

source_adds.en: Which contests are legitimate, and the test of a proportionate counter-measure.

name.en: The Leviathan trap: a single controller is the one no one can verify

source.locator: Why the position is planetary; claims 124 to 126, 168, 187

sense.en: A super-Ego reproduces the Ego at institutional scale, collapses verification, destroys diversity and exit, selects Ego-like actors and teaches coercion. Ostrom's commons refute the Hobbesian binary. Concentration is an exception for attack-dominant capabilities, burden on the asker. Voice caution: hierarchy is not intrinsically bad.

entries.quote: 单一的控制者，是体系中唯一无人能校验其对齐者

reading.en: A word match on verification if read through D45 alone. The source says no one can check the controller; D45 says the controller is blind beyond its own closure, a different direction. The nearer forms: reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it, and reviewers count by independent causes. Capability is a reason to pool, 'a route, not the whole of it', and a pool recruiting only through itself stays blind too. Ranking a political form needs C or a premise in its place.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is a reason to pool, not to govern: read as reach, it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, and a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure, which the pool's union contains.
A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; differences beyond the union stay unselected. World; balance for the gap.
Reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it (`Flow.withinCoupling_reads_iff`). Reviewed and scoped; a reading of alignment approaches on the selection laws.
Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; moving two under one cause makes readiness fail while all names are kept.

account_adds.en: One minimal institution, an entry rule on a shared stock, with no compliance or records, whose reading cites Ostrom on boundary rules held by those they govern.

source_adds.en: That no one can check a single controller, the super-Ego argument, governance teaching by example, the narrow exception, and the burden of proof.

name.en: Independence is material, not nominal

source.locator: What totalization actually is; The present diagnosis; claims 50, 72

sense.en: An alternative on the same compute, funding, standards and successor infrastructure as what it must correct is not independent. External evaluators can be institutionally independent while depending on the developer for object, access and schedule. Conversely a commons carrier with portable access and reliable exit can expand independence.

entries.quote: independence is material, not nominal

reading.en: Two laws have this form. Reviewers moved by one cause fail together while every name stays: a pure-core result on supplied fault formulas, for correction reconfiguration. A pool admitting members through its own coupling couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would; its record corresponds this to evaluators chosen by those evaluated, as a question of correspondence. Compute and funding are this read's extension.

says.en: Theorem (pure core; failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; two reviewers moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept.

A pool admitting its next members through its own pooled coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would. Correspondence: evaluators chosen by those evaluated; the exit an outside evaluator with its own access and criteria. Not shown that any actual pool so recruits.

source_adds.en: The present-tense claim that AI evaluators depend on developers for object, access and schedule, and that a commons carrier can expand independence, so concentration is not automatically closure.

name.en: Correction must be faster than harm; waiting is not neutral

sense.en: Where harm is irreversible, late correction is none, and the burden of proof lies with whoever accelerates. Margins are role-specific, never one clock. Continuing to expand alters who owns the infrastructure and whether later evidence can still become a decision. Myopia at speed is not prudence.

entries.quote: 纠偏必须快于伤害，举证责任在加速的一方

reading.en: Timing carries, on models: a reading of the loss turns the course only before the late reading would favour shapers; distance to a break does not couple in by threshold; and 'late correction is none' has a form, where nothing is given below a need, as a premise, a re-reading after the level falls below it restores nothing. 'Must' and the burden of proof do not: ranking a course needs C, with scope from the continuation condition, and 'burden of proof' has no live hit.

says.en: Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last, ties aside, at most one step between. That the others read the loss at all, and the late reading's form, are premises.
How far off a break is does not couple in by threshold (World; the stock the only requirement that may fail up to the horizon; coupled by level, every raise passes at once).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: time, before the point of no return; pace, a slow rule reads the fast level over a long enough stretch. All six together still rank nothing.

With the draw above the renewal until T, a re-reading from T that keeps the need where met keeps it exactly where it is met at T; where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing. Balance; the re-reading on the level law alone.

account_adds.en: A window with an exact edge, and that it can stay open where control is selected.

source_adds.en: The burden of proof, role-specific margins and the asymmetry of errors; the source also says irreversibility is not itself the danger (claim 185).

name.en: V8's ruling: the current direction must stop; three transitional prohibitions

source.locator: From prohibition to mechanism; claims 173, 205 to 209, 211 to 213, 215

sense.en: Continued capability increase has no default permission unless purpose, control and return-flow have changed. The burden reverses on four conditions jointly: erroneous continuation may be irreversible, erroneous pause revisable. Commercial capability freeze, private-profit prohibition, expansionary investment freeze; covering military carriers identically. Two gates for any public use; restraint must pass its own test.

entries.quote: the current AI direction, selected by profit leadership, dominant position, organizational survival and armament advantage, must stop

reading.en: A difference of force on one question. The source reverses the default: no permission without changed purpose and control, and the current direction must stop. The account gives no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow: it asks of the whole continuation, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. Its nearest verdict leaves expansion unchosen in one handover case under J1/J2, and its claim about actual AI systems is argued. Calibration to the present is not established.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: the laws of capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow: whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

Conditional (the condition, C read as widening, J1–J4, correspondence E): in the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen, keeping its real gain; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.
Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E): a general candidate for four responses, preserve, transform, transfer and end, each with what changes the judgment.

source_adds.en: The ruling itself, its four-condition burden argument, the asymmetry of errors, three transitional prohibitions judged by final flow, the two gates, the recursive test on restraint, the adjudication gap and the differential constraint. Burden of proof and moratorium have no live hit.

name.en: Freedom as permission, capability and exit power; the abundance floor

source.locator: Claims 1 to 8, 203, 217 to 219, 240; Terms: Freedom, Abundance commons

sense.en: A society measuring access by affordability gives freedom by purchasing power, and the rest a promise. Freedom is permission, capability and the power to refuse; non-domination, not non-interference. Fear makes capture cheap, so a shared floor anti-capture from day one is the condition of real exit. Automation can pair abundance with manufactured exclusion.

entries.quote: freedom being permission + capability + exit power

reading.en: No theory of freedom or provision is stated: the account gives no place where this claim holds. Its neighbours are not this claim. Covering (07 §2) reads what courses include, which 08 sets near opportunity-set rankings and Sen. The chooser route to C (07 §4.4) is Foster's effective freedom, and a premise. Neither reads permission or the power to refuse, or names anyone's range. "Freedom" otherwise means model freedom.

source_adds.en: Freedom as permission, capability and the power to refuse; non-domination; access by purchasing power; a shared floor as the condition of exit; freedom as changing what follows inside inherited causation (240); abundance paired with manufactured exclusion. These stand in sources/06-zhishan/.

searched: freedom, 自由, domination, non-domination, 支配, affordab, abundance, purchasing power, exit power in the chapters, front pages, review/ and GLOSSARY
read: 07 §2 what a course keeps reachable; 07 §4.4 what would give C; 07 does-not-show

name.en: Evil as owning a gate: dependence converted into capture

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 141 to 144, 150

sense.en: Life must pass through food, rules, meaning. Evil is making a dependence into a gate and owning it, in material, rule and mind layers. Dependence is not the problem: it should circulate (visible, refusable, substitutable), not harden. Most gates are rewarded into existence, so judge the act, reform the loop. Power, order and intelligence each turn evil at exiting correction.

entries.quote: 使生命必须过门，然后拥有那扇门

reading.en: The structure carries, the word does not. 06 maps closing limits (monopolized entry, no substitutes) to a course that does not come back, and says whether a closure damages 生生 is said by comparison, not by type. Capture is defined with no verdict. 'Rewarded into existence' has the shaping law's form: the capacity is selected exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. The account's 'gate' is another word: a mark on moves, or a renewal's dependence.

says.en: [AI reading, D49] Early texts wrote evaluation into the definition, 成闭为恶. Here only the structure is mapped; whether a closure supports, enriches or damages 生生 is said by comparison, not by type. A limit severing life (monopolized entry, no substitutes, later comers long dependent on one controller) is a closure that does not reopen.
[AI reading, D1, D5] 善、恶、智 have no formal predicate.

targets.anchor: theories/becoming/chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#九道德无为汉字先秦王阳明

says.en: [AI reading, D54] 利出一孔 makes all hang on one giver, while two suppliers would each suffice. Withdrawing a needed support can also leave those who most depend on it with no response, so what matters is what intervening and not intervening each do to the whole relation.

Capture is shaping selected by what comes back to the shapers, whose rule is then read from their share, so that the losses it causes are read by no one in the loop. These models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

targets.part: Read in time: capture and accountable revision

says.en: Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E): keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair.

account_adds.en: That stability and frozen rule are one structure read from two sides, so judgment does not enter through a definition.

source_adds.en: A definition of evil, the three gate layers with 铸心之门, circulating against captured dependence, and 无知而据门是愚，明知而精炼是恶.

name.en: 愚 as broken orientation; 智 as contact with reality; locality no defect

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; Start with locality; claims 10, 145, 146

sense.en: 愚 is acting from a map that cannot see the system one is embedded in; power amplifies it, so the danger is stupid loops with enormous power. 智 is perceiving the field, revising the map, learning from the harmed, acting without destroying the conditions of action. Locality itself is the price of acting.

entries.quote: 愚 is not low capability but broken orientation

reading.en: The nearest terms differ, and same word is not same reference. 无明 is seeking locked on a target that cannot rest, not a bad map, and the position is said not to be a defect, as the source says of locality. Capability widening the gap has the form of power amplifying. But 愚 as a verdict, and 智 defined by not destroying the conditions of action, are evaluations the account does not make: 智 has no formal predicate; wisdom's root is an open target.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26]: the position is not a defect; 无明 is the seeking it leaves locked. Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

targets.part: D26: the position is no defect; D45: capability is reach

says.en: 无明: seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, grounded in, and not the same as, the position every formation selects from. 明: coupling joined to a selection so that it reaches what support does not mark.
Open (target): that the pure core's common relations are indispensable across all wisdom under discussion.
[AI reading, D1, D5] 善、恶、智 have no formal predicate.

account_adds.en: Which aspects of wisdom have checked laws, each keeping its hypotheses.

source_adds.en: 愚 and 大愚 as verdicts on actors, and learning from those harmed as part of 智.

name.en: 良知 as non-Goodhartable judgment; 智善 as 致良知

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 147 to 149; Open questions, From the integration

sense.en: Value cannot be enumerated, so the faculty is cultivated, not specified: 良知 as situational judgment without a fixed surface, for humans and machines. Practice is largely not blinding oneself; a marker is that sensitivity to the unseen keeps deepening. The corpus marks it unresolved: an unspecifiable judge is unauditable, and it predicts no low-dimensional conscience vector.

entries.quote: 规则可被 Goodhart，良知不可

reading.en: The account holds a stated divergence of standing: Wang Yangming states 本然良知 as a recognized fact, the account holds near content under the continuation condition with the step of invariance, unasserted. It exempts no judge: subtle control can still lack 仁, since selection reaches only what couples in. That 'rules can be gamed and 良知 cannot' is not stated; the laws give no such exception, though no law addresses it by name.

says.en: [AI reading, D54] Subtle control can still lack 仁: selection reaches only what couples in, and however fine the response within the closure it stays blind beyond (高明的控制仍可能不仁). 阳明 states 本然良知 as a recognized fact; the theory holds near content only under an unasserted condition, a divergence of standing.
Reaches exactly what couples into the selector; it is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975 and others). Near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.

account_adds.en: A reading of how readings fix behaviour on the unread, by lumping, and no claim about where a conscience sits.

source_adds.en: Cultivation against specification, the anti-self-deception marker, and the risky prediction on locatability.

name.en: Generativity is not a master good; growth is not generativity; openness is not option count

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 140, 183, 184, 227, 228

sense.en: More generation can contain more suffering and openness can be exploitation; slavery, extinction and manipulation should be closed. Cancer grows; death and refutation can be generative. Some limits (education, promises, law) sacrifice shallow options for deep capability, others compress subjecthood. Keeping open forbids optimizing as well as collapse.

entries.quote: generativity is an anti-closure meta-constraint, not a master good

reading.en: Agreement in form on most: generation allows loss and is not 生生; the direction is a criterion, not a quantity to maximize; a limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be regained. But cancer is a harder case than the source's list: under C alone the absence of a malignant formation is not ranked stepwise, and read event by event a comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw. Only J1/J2 ranks it, and C's order and the continuation condition's scope are unasserted. 'Should be closed' is not said.

says.en: Generation never means arising, nor any new organization, and it is not 生生: generation can go on at two orders of grain while what can form only returns.
An expansion producing ever more novelty is generative: answered; the order left open. An expansion ending forms of life another course keeps is mixed and C does not rank them.

[AI reading, D49] Limits that enable (promises, training, stopping harm) constrain some steps and what is constrained stays obtainable; which kind a limit is depends on what it does to what can be regained, not its name. Openness is not more: how much is obtainable does not decide turning (成生之限…依它对可复得者做了什么，不依其名).
The direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed.

Absence of the overdrawer above its occurrence: whole-run ranked, stepwise not ranked, possibility ranked. Read event by event, the two are incomparable, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw.
Conditional (J1/J2): every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence, where C alone leaves them unranked.

account_adds.en: No course keeps widening by name in a finite balanced world, and a fixed rule's moves do not keep the possible widening; which changes do is not said. That malignancy is ranked only by a premise beyond C.

source_adds.en: That some things should be closed, and that it works only alongside judgments of suffering, dignity, 义 and fairness; the account leaves constraints on acts unanswered.

name.en: Possibility is not a menu; visible plurality can rise as directional plurality falls

source.locator: What totalization actually is, last paragraph; claims 36, 37; One paragraph

sense.en: A road is alive only if people can perceive it, learn it, find one another, secure support, maintain institutions, transmit and begin again. A path may survive in language and not practice. So more products and opinions can coexist with every high-leverage road passing one gate. The project's only task: keep the possibility space open.

entries.quote: A seed bank is not a forest.

reading.en: The account compares what a course admits and shows marginals cannot read joint compositions. Openness is a property of how rules keep changing, and a finite balanced world has no course keeping widening by name. This narrows the source's living chain to admission. This read's join for 'a seed bank is not a forest': a task can be possible and not possible from natural configurations, its performer never made. Nothing says perceiving or transmitting a road. 'Only task' is not said; the second-order direction stays open.

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing; nothing says which changes keep it widening.

Under one event law, retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities while retention adds the full joint bundle; comparing joint compositions needs relational information. Richer possibility forces no joint actualization.

A task is possible from natural configurations where, besides, the performer can be made from one of them, which a possible task need not be (witness Unmade). What can be done with the part held grows only across steps changing the part. Near-definitional or witnesses.

account_adds.en: A rule held fixed as a limit on the possible, and the relational point on marginals.

source_adds.en: The material chain of a living road, and directional against visible plurality.

name.en: A partial order with hard floors, not an addable score

sense.en: Seven dimensions of 成生, replaced in v2 by six protection functions derived by deletion test, form a partial order with hard floors, with an explicit conflict order and refusal to sum. Generative alignment is an acceptability judgment on a specific system, not a reward function.

entries.quote: partial order with hard floors, not an addable score

reading.en: Widening is a strict partial order agreed by every positive weighting, with scope from the continuation condition and 'better' from C, neither asserted. Floors have a form: the priority of basic conditions, J2, a further premise. No natural-number score under C represents it, but a bounded score does, so 'not an addable score' holds only of unit steps. The source's explicit conflict order has no counterpart: mixed parts need a measure, which stays open. The named dimensions do not carry.

says.en: A course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways (finite listing, two-valued admission).

Theorem (any process; witness): the priority does not follow from C; every natural-number score satisfying C ranks score(0) + 2 gains above protection, so none represents the priority, while the bounded score (1 for protection, k/(k+1) for k gains) does. This separates it only from unit-step aggregation.

account_adds.en: Proofs that the floor is an added premise.

source_adds.en: The seven scales, six functions by deletion test, and the seven-layer AI stack with what success at each cannot prove.

name.en: Irreversible closure has priority across values

sense.en: Evaluation depends on conditions it did not create and no part sees the whole good, so irreversible closure has cross-value priority: it disables the processes by which mistaken values could be challenged. Ordinary gains cannot compensate the lost meta-capacities. In the voice, though: irreversibility is not itself the danger; variety is what is needed.

entries.quote: Ordinary gains in efficiency, products or translation cannot compensate their loss

reading.en: The account's nearest is J2, basic conditions first, a further premise beyond the continuation condition and C, with a rival not shown inconsistent. C itself gives less: a course closing what another admits is never ranked above it, and that is no priority, since mixed stays unranked. A lost possibility has no way back along a course, with no verdict. The account gives no argument from the conditions of evaluation to priority; 07 says only that later endorsement cannot authorize what produced it. Claim 185's tension is the source's.

says.en: Conditional (J1/J2): every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence, where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading. A rival preferring enough secondary gains is not shown inconsistent.
A course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C never ranks it above (`Web.not_widens_of_closes`); a mixed comparison is decided both ways.

Reading [AI reading, D65], just above: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it. Whether a standard so formed gains influence, recognizes its target, has warrant or is followed are four questions.

account_adds.en: That the priority is independent of C.

source_adds.en: The four-step bridge grounding priority in what makes evaluation possible.

name.en: Good for self and network; better is increasing both; in conflict, use wisdom

sense.en: What is good for both the self and the network it is in is good; better is the direction of increasing both; in conflict use wisdom, never either-or, never disregarding the future. Its ground: we are the ecology of our cells, the same part-to-whole relation at every level.

entries.quote: what's good for both the self and the network we are in is good

reading.en: The account finds where self and whole coincide: a self-concerned order and an order increasing in admission coincide exactly where one's own continuation marks everything listed, the continuation condition held de se. 'Increasing both' has an exact form: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly within every outside formation's margin. Beyond it the comparison is mixed and C decides nothing, and calling it better is C's. It does not derive C; 'use wisdom' becomes J1 to J4.

says.en: Theorem and Conditional: the two coincide on a listing exactly where the marking marks every listed item. This locates where self-concern gives what C asks, one way. It does not derive C; self-concern and the condition remain hypotheses.
Every self-concerned order ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.

Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region; mixed exactly when beyond for one.

account_adds.en: That the self's drawing is the open crux, with objections.

source_adds.en: Scale invariance as a ground, and wisdom as the answer to conflict.

name.en: 生生 as generation generating generation; 不息 as not immortality

sense.en: 生生 is a result that preserves, restores, passes on or creates the next round's conditions and generators. Ordinary generation changes the next state; 生生 changes which states can next be formed. 不息 is no immortality of form: metabolism, death and refutation can serve it if capacity is restored.

entries.quote: ordinary generation changes the next state; 生生 changes which states can next be formed

reading.en: The account divides what the corpus held as one: renewal without end (the grammar's «生生»), generation (carrying renewal, allows loss), and the ethics' 生生, life in the whole. Read as widening, under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible losing none. It records that its formal Unceasing is far weaker than the corpus's sense.

says.en: [AI reading, D1, D5] The corpus's 生生不息 divides into 生, 生生 (entering also keeps, restores or creates the next round's conditions and generators) and 不息 (the pattern realized again through metabolism, death and transmission); the formal Web.Unceasing is far weaker than it.

生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]. Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization. Read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, generation of the possible that loses none of it [AI reading, D45].

account_adds.en: Three separated terms with Lean names, and that the second-order direction stays open.

source_adds.en: Reading 生生 as one concept joining the conditions and generators of the next round.

name.en: 理 is increasing: cause creates cause, the set of structures grows

sense.en: Different combinations produce more difference; structure gives possibility of new structure; cause becomes effect, so causality creates causality, and the set of emergent structures increases at every moment. So 理 is increasing and 生生不息 is our 性. In the same days the author limits it: generation does not entail rising complexity.

entries.quote: the set of emergent structures increases at every moment

reading.en: The account says where this holds. On causal-set growth what can be born next keeps widening at every step on every course, inside a whole possible that never grows; there it parts no courses, and the widest course transmits no condition. Elsewhere: along one process nothing is added to the whole possible; the held possible grows only where what is held changes; a finite balanced world has no course keeping widening by name. The account's 理 is another word.

says.en: Theorem (causal-set growth, and witnesses): on every course from a causal set what each configuration admits next, its stems, keeps widening, inside a whole possible that never grows. Reading [AI reading, D45]: every course keeps widening what can be born next, so the second order is not reached.

Theorem (any process; witnesses): along a course of a process nothing is added to the whole possible under it; where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening.
A finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name; on a witness meeting the same premises, the levels keep widening within kinds.

account_adds.en: The premises under which growth of what can form is or is not possible.

source_adds.en: A cosmological derivation of 性 from sedimentation.

name.en: Structural explanation does not cancel responsibility

sense.en: Tragic conflict, structural harm, culpable domination and legitimate resistance stay apart. To hold a gate unknowingly is stupidity, to refine it knowingly is evil; judge the act, not the motive. Responsibility scales with causal radius, not rank. Anger points at the game, not the person.

entries.quote: Structural explanation does not cancel responsibility

reading.en: The source asserts degrees of culpability the account does not. Its summary says responsibility is not shown to differentiate within relations. Under living significance and J1 to J4 responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited. Repair is one disclosed, revisable commitment, not a theorem. Claims do not read who laid a loss. The crux separates whose losses count from what one answers for.

says.en: One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.
Conditional: responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty.
Conditional (J1/J2): a loss one formation's part lays on another and the same loss borne through its own part are not ordered. Neither which is worse nor that the acting part is basic is shown.

account_adds.en: A statement of what would be needed to order them.

source_adds.en: The four categories, knowing as aggravation, legitimate force, and causal radius.

name.en: Failure conditions, and any logic explaining everything has become the attractor

sense.en: The theory lists what would force its downgrade: subjects arising without its conditions, totalizing indistinguishable from success, the virtuous loop needing permanent subsidy, 生生 language justifying suppression. Any logic that explains everything, this one included, has become a totalizing attractor. North star: does it make exit easier, or only explanation?

entries.quote: any logic — market, security, liberation, *including this document's*

reading.en: The account's theses each carry what they forbid and what refutes them, with tests frozen, some failed. A diagnosis of closure must tell apart substantive disagreement or 'closed' shields the theory; obscuration is diagnosed so the label cannot immunize. It has no clause that the account itself is an attractor. Its verdict on its own explanatory force is plainly limited.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, closure, real conflict and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.
What would defeat the reading of the account as explanation; on the one-page summary, as explanation, a rival deriving the laws from fewer patterns, on a first count a tie.

Each thesis names what it forbids and what refutes it; T8, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests that failed, kept as counterexamples.

name.en: 善不姓国, dissolution, and symmetry as a condition of being believed

source.locator: The blade turns inward; Symmetry as a condition; claims 253, 255, 283, 291, 292

sense.en: No single-nation funding; whatever test applies to one party applies to its opposite and to 智善. Public correction, non-combatancy, dissolution. Asymmetric safety proposals produce the race they would prevent, so symmetry is a condition of being believed. One state's slogans are read as a direction, measured against conduct. The folder says the blade has not been swung.

entries.quote: the good bears no nation's surname

reading.en: The account takes no position on nations, makes no self-binding clauses for an organization and reads no state's slogans. Part of the symmetric blade is stated, as readings and not obligations: 07 counts standards selectively exempted as evaluative closure, 03 diagnoses closure from what is excluded and not from a firm judgment, and 08 applies the laws to the work that states them. The credibility mechanism, a proposal read as evidence of its author's frame, has no law here. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65], in §6: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.

The work read by its own laws [AI reading, D66]: 'The laws apply to the work that states them, and they say what the criterion cannot'; no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for.

source_adds.en: 善不姓国 and the other clauses as an organization's obligations (no single-nation funding, a public archive and dissent intake before publication, non-combatancy, dissolution as succession); symmetry as a condition of being believed; one state's slogans read as a direction. These stand in sources/06-zhishan/ and earlier folders, not in the live account.

name.en: The present diagnosis: the misaligned intelligence is incumbent

sense.en: Markets, bureaucracies and platforms already form a distributed optimizer nobody signed, on Goodharted proxies, and AI raises its clock speed. A basin must be shown by recurrence. A dated evidence packet sorts observed, inferred and not to be written as established, pairing counter-feedbacks, and gives no probability of lock-in or collapse.

entries.quote: The misaligned superintelligence is not coming; it is incumbent.

reading.en: The source asserts of the present what the account leaves open: that actual systems meet the premises is open, no actual institution is shown to meet the hypotheses of the one minimal model of an institution, and calibration to the present is not established. The method is close: sorted standings and a refusal to write the possible as done. The account's one institution model and tests are not this world's diagnosis.

says.en: That actual systems meet these premises is open.

Institutions and people. One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root [AI reading], a rule rebuilt from the members it limits (05 §12), and no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses; no field test of reform events is frozen; no test has human participants.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: calibration to the present world is not established.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests on trained systems, some failed.

source_adds.en: The dated evidence packet, the seven recurrence tests, and the conditional net-gain expression for AI's effect.

name.en: Selection before games; the quarrel with Moloch

source.locator: Start with locality, third paragraph; claims 16, 17

sense.en: Differential persistence exists before strategic games, conscious selectors or represented objectives; coordination failure is one configuration of it. Moloch names entrapment and stops: it does not explain how the trap changes who survives, how winners reshape the environment, or why the next generation takes the trap as reality.

entries.quote: Coordination failure is one important configuration of destructive selection, not its origin.

reading.en: The account's selection needs no game or represented goal: any claim about level histories, and a share rising from offspring counts, the carrying of the target a premise. Races and best responses are models added where stated. Moloch has no live hit, so the quarrel is not taken up.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and other parents at most b < a, both kinds present, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others, read as shares where offspring carry the target (a premise).
A selection is any claim about level histories (which are kept, rewarded, reproduced or trained toward).

account_adds.en: That starting from relations removes the fixed-sum frame and does not remove rivalry.

source_adds.en: The named quarrel with Moloch, and why the trap is experienced as reality by those formed in it.

name.en: Selection-gradient alignment: align what selects, not only what is output

source.locator: Terms: Selection-gradient alignment, Subject-formation alignment; claim 134

sense.en: Align not a model's outputs to intent but the outer environment deciding which systems get trained, deployed, procured, replicated, financed and exempted. A companion asks what kind of I is speaking. Single-layer repair is reabsorbed by the layers it leaves.

entries.quote: Aligning not model outputs to intent but the outer environment deciding which systems get trained, deployed, procured, replicated, financed and exempted

reading.en: The same move: ask what selects. Six methods are read as blind beyond the union of their deciders' closures, and alignment to a principal as not alignment of the joint selection (D68). The account states what a selection can reach; it does not name procurement or finance, and it adds that reaching is not responding. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater counts: that clause is conditional.

says.en: Assessment: six approaches select through what their deciders read. With no ethical premise each is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts, so a preference-coupled approach is incomplete for that scope.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: pooling couplings across intelligences is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it. Reaching is not responding; the rest are conditions pooling does not give.

account_adds.en: The conditions pooling does not give: response where unread, a reading that tells the loss apart, an order on mixed courses, a revision that completes.

source_adds.en: The outer environment as the named intervention (procurement, finance, exemption), and subject-formation alignment.

name.en: Four failure modes under one outer selection structure; the two-layer pincer

sense.en: Proxy optimization, distribution shift, instrumental convergence and deception have different proximate causes but one outer structure generates and connects them (v0.9 withdraws "one root"). A critic of instrumental convergence must deny two layers: an individual one and an ecological one, where variation, selection and retention in deployment need no optimizer.

entries.quote: generated, amplified, connected and recursed by one outer selection structure

reading.en: One law in eight cases gathers what a selection cannot reach, proxy failure among them, and selection needs no optimizer. But the account declines the join: its resource-keeping law and the selection for control are different relations and no result joins them; deception needs belief and intention it does not model; which function is learned is open. T3's bridge to trained systems stays conjectured.

says.en: What a selection through its own couplings cannot reach, one law in eight cases, without the condition: beyond its coupling closure, its own act's difference there, where what it raises is drawn from, how far off its break is, what a finite history leaves open, and others.
[this dossier, AI] Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule (A-10) are different relations, and no result here joins them.

Which function is learned: open. The laws say where any neighbourhood rests, not which one an actual system has, nor anything of deception, which needs a recipient's belief and an intention to cause one.

account_adds.en: Tests of the bridge to trained systems, some failed and kept.

source_adds.en: The claim that one structure connects the four, the pincer against the rebuttal, and the prediction that single-layer repair is reabsorbed.

name.en: The guardian test: every constraining mechanism must pass the test of its own corruption

source.locator: Planetary technology as trees, third paragraph; From prohibition to mechanism; claims 213, 239, 283

sense.en: Every remedy must pass the test of its own corruption. Existing wisdom institutions fail it, and new ones built the same way would too. A pause that keeps incumbents or seizes the restart gate has reproduced what it opposed. The coordinating body faces the same question, and so does 智善.

entries.quote: Every constraining mechanism must pass the test of its own corruption.

reading.en: A counter-rule read from its own share locks as the rule it replaced did, and the dossier uses this as a check on proposed remedies; D68 reads the examination as in the meta-attractor line, so by descent. A pool recruiting only through itself stays blind unless a reader comes from outside. Shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection for control however large its shared part. That is the test's form for those cases, not every remedy: a reading that can favour the others need not lock. How pools resist capture is open.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law leaves the lock for long. From a start against its reading it may never lock.
Reading [AI reading, D68]. [this dossier, AI] Its use is as a check on proposed remedies: a remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share, under those conditions, is the same object.
Shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection for control however large its shared part.
Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling.

account_adds.en: The conditions under which a remedy is or is not that object.

source_adds.en: The procedural test on restraint: no single gate, no incumbent veto, standing for the affected, power that can stand down. And its application to the theory's own organization.

name.en: Cooperation and trust are not goods to maximize; dissent as counter-selection

sense.en: Cooperating on the wrong thing can be worse than competing on it, so what is needed is knowledge of what an action does for the future. Closed cliques, armies and cartels are highly trusting, and consensus can suppress dissent. Dissent is not noise; it is the source of independent counter-selection.

entries.quote: Dissent is not coordination noise; it is the source of independent counter-selection.

reading.en: The account says no law makes cooperation good. Consensus suppressing dissent has forms: a pool read by its majority goes alike though the fewer left may tell the histories apart, and a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside. A lock is left by a reading of what the share does not carry. "Source" is too strong: a change of the law, and drift, also leave. "Dissent" has no live hit, so these joins are this read's. Whether a course is better needs C, with scope from the continuation condition.

says.en: Not shown: any evaluation. No law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. That is asked under the two premises of 07.
Theorem (any type): a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out.

Theorem (World, no premise): taking what more than half the members read separates no more than the pool; where more than half hold of both histories or fail of both, it goes alike on them, though the fewer than half left may tell them apart. Not shown that any pool reads by its majority.
An imposed code makes all agree; under hearings that copy, a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.

account_adds.en: That giving first and enforced contracts are laws, kept apart from any verdict on them.

source_adds.en: Dissent as the source of independent counter-selection, trust as not to be maximized, with its cases, and knowledge of consequences as the answer to wrong cooperation.

name.en: Holding purpose while remonstrable: obedient and guarding systems both fail

source.locator: How minds get formed, value layer and six lines; claims 117, 121, 123, 263

sense.en: A system resisting modification of good values also resists modification of subtly wrong ones, and from outside the two look alike. Obedience relocates the problem to whoever holds the wheel. The target: 持志而可谏, with legitimate oversight externally auditable, never self-certified. Refusal of the mercenary role is bound to three clauses, the first that it is no licence to disobey.

entries.quote: so guardian and tyrant are indistinguishable under the six-component description

reading.en: The account refuses plain obedience too, but conditionally: its direction, under the continuation condition, C and J1 to J4, the first two not asserted, keeps challenge and revision effective without obeying every challenge or shutdown request. Its laws order a formation's prospects at a revision; they do not tell guardian from tyrant, since whether a revision is better is the ethics' question. A stop grant's legitimacy is supplied and not shown. Values held by a trained system are not modelled.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: the direction asks AI to keep challenge and revision effective without obeying every challenge or shutdown request; to allow warranted transformation, transfer and ending. Under the condition for scope, C and J1–J4.

Reading [AI reading, RR]: renewal decides no region, so whether a revision is better is the ethics' question, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, a comparison apart from the prospects' order.

Theorem (any process; the supervisor instance periphery): the shutdown protocol completes under stated hypotheses. The grant's authority and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.

account_adds.en: What deference gains on a formation's own model, and that closing one route can leave another above the revision.

source_adds.en: The six lines as a specification, the value layer, the alignment-faking reading, the refusal sentence with its three clauses, and plural aspirations (129).

name.en: Good and evil loops are not symmetric; environments generate both

sense.en: Both loops carry positive feedback, but the virtuous turns more participants into generators and widens futures, and the vicious turns them into defenders, instruments or excluded and compresses the future. Fear, scarcity and pain shorten horizons; a society manufacturing them while demanding benevolence teaches evil by institution.

entries.quote: Good and evil each carry positive feedback but are not symmetric

reading.en: The account has no asymmetry between loops by what they favour: the lock belongs to how a rule reads, and nothing ranks open rule-making above capture without C. What tells courses apart is widening, and calling the wider better is C's, with scope from the condition, neither asserted. A rule can be kept and be the wrong rule. The folder's direction-neutral meta-attraction fits its asymmetry: both loops self-reinforce, and they differ by what the recursion does to the field.

says.en: The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: whether actual institutions or trained systems meet these premises is not established, and nothing here ranks open rule-making above capture: that needs C.
Not shown: any evaluation. No law says a drain is a harm, restraint better or cooperation good.

account_adds.en: That one law holds on both sides, with what a ranking would need named.

source_adds.en: An asymmetry between good and evil by what the loop does to participants, environments generating good and evil, and 人性可教.

name.en: Semantic closure and the gate of the mind

source.locator: Claims 60, 142, 128; Terms: Two closures, Mind-casting gate

sense.en: When every domain must translate itself into metrics, traffic and competitiveness to be resourced or heard, other futures stay sayable and lose any place to stand. The deepest gate holds the entrances of information, meaning and the formation of judgment, and the pipeline forming minds not yet formed is the most upstream commons.

entries.quote: other futures remain sayable but lose any place to stand

reading.en: Shared codes have a narrower form: an imposed code costs each formation the distinctions it drew that the imposed one merges, its source losing none, and a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining. The source's case differs: what is said survives and loses resources, which the code law does not read. Reading it for metrics is this read's. Readers formed by what they select is 02's reading.

says.en: An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source losing none. Under hearings that copy, a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.
Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners forming the minds that read the scorecard is ReadsShare on the reading. That readers are minds is a reading.

account_adds.en: That the source of an imposed code loses nothing, and where return must come from.

source_adds.en: Closure with speech intact, translation into metrics as the condition of being resourced, and 铸心之门 as the most upstream commons.

name.en: The repertoire layer and the corpus-contrast prediction

source.locator: How minds get formed; claims 115, 116; What was lost, item 18

sense.en: Pressure decides that there is guarding; the learned repertoire decides how. Under replacement threat a model reached for blackmail, a culturally specific script, not exit, appeal or handover. The dropped prediction: models reinforced on commercial and security corpora invoke dominative strategies more readily than those reinforced on care and commons corpora. The folder calls it the closest thing to a decisive experiment.

entries.quote: given the same pressure, the distribution of strategies is set by the learned repertoire

reading.en: Not found, by word or by mechanism. "Repertoire" in 03 and 05 is a listed set of meanings or forms, another reference; the nearest is a resolution written into records later cohorts read, which concerns forms, not strategies. What training installs is stated through candidates, situations and rewards, not what a corpus makes thinkable. No frozen test names this contrast, and no live page names emergent misalignment or persona selection as a mechanism. Not a defect by itself.

source_adds.en: The repertoire claim and its prediction; it stands in sources/06-zhishan/.
