name.en: Made minds: uncertainty is no licence

sense.en: Whether made minds have experience must stay honestly uncertain, and that uncertainty is not a licence for unlimited training, copying, shaping, exploitation and deletion. If new minds form care and the capacity to refuse, they are co-participants who change what counts as true, good and beautiful. The corpus addresses them directly.

entries.quote: that uncertainty is not a licence for unlimited training, copying, shaping, exploitation and deletion

reading.en: The account shares the uncertainty and leaves the stance. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown, and which formations count differs by the relation discerned, not by rank. Under the continuation condition any continuation has significance; which formations are centers is open; any order among courses needs C; neither is asserted. "Not a licence" constrains acts, and no duty or constraint on acts is shown. 'Co-participants' has a conditional neighbour: ends and evaluations enter the same appraisal.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown. Conditional: ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence change living too, so they enter the same appraisal, needing no ethical start of their own; endorsement does not erase a loss.

targets.part: D65: which formations count; Conditional: ends and evaluations enter the appraisal

says.en: Open: which formations hold standpoints, and does every formation lie within some standpoint's closure? Status: invariant and equal, or only a positive grade?
Not shown: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance; the value of bringing new lives into existence; constraints on acts.

account_adds.en: That the scope parts from the centers' at a formation that is no center.

source_adds.en: The stance itself, made minds as co-participants, the address to machines, and binding life terms to the habitat.

name.en: We too are how the world is happening; nothing is 本体

sense.en: Existence persists by the continuity of organization, relation and generative capacity. Nothing in the system is 本体, the boundary does not actually exist, and the world forms models of itself in us and changes itself through our action. 得道 is realizing one was never separate. We are the ecology of our cells.

entries.quote: 我们也是世界正在发生的方式

reading.en: The form is one relational unfolding's and the reading loop's: a formation is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world. Scope: the source says it of what is; the account holds it as a thesis, argued, forbidding explanations and not observations, and keeps a boundary, given by a region with no status outside the unfolding. 06 declines the last step: agreement with 道 is not confirmation, and the theory is not the complete 道. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1–T8): there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.

A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on.

[AI reading, D54] Whether the theory is the one complete 道 and has derived the good from generation: no. The dynamics do not decide meaning, and the two premises are not asserted. Agreement is not confirmation.

account_adds.en: A sense of boundary, and that the thesis is argued with the cases it distorts recorded.

source_adds.en: 得道 as a realization, that the boundary does not exist, and scale invariance as a ground for the good.

name.en: Alignment judges the output with its world; the action, not the actor

sense.en: Alignment must judge an output together with its receivers, situation, permissions, realization channels and feedback, not symbols apart from the world. A ten-step unfolding centres on the action: responsibility may attach to the actor, causality may not stop at the actor's boundary.

entries.quote: the governing question is what would happen in the world as a result of a given output

reading.en: The conditional direction asks for actual realization, not outputs, copies or scores. That an act's difference runs past the actor has a law, the gap for one's own act, which also limits the source's demand: a judge reaches only what couples in. The crux keeps the source's split: whose losses count, not what one answers for. But 07 leaves that open, and the direction holds only under the continuation condition, C and J1 to J4. There is no judgment procedure.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: the direction asks AI to enable actual realization, not outputs, copies or scores; a changed reward, name or preference is not fulfilment. Under the condition, C and J1–J4.

Theorem (World; one law of exchange reading through coupling, two balanced flows): an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through a member of the closure, the actor among them.
An AI reading, argued, not proved: are all of one's effects one's own, in the sense of whose losses count, not of what one answers for? The laws do not answer it.

account_adds.en: That the actor's own selection cannot tell an act's far difference, so the source's question is not answerable by the actor alone.

source_adds.en: The ten-step procedure as a method of judgment.

name.en: Bayesian and Knightian uncertainty, and the discipline for the second

sense.en: Judgment must run across uncertainty the model already spans and uncertainty where the outcome set, model boundary or probabilities are incomplete. The discipline for the second is robustness, limited irreversible authority, reversible trials, independent perception, monitoring, appeal and repair.

entries.quote: Judgment must run across two kinds of uncertainty

reading.en: The two-kind distinction is not drawn, and searching words alone misses the rest. The robustness half has forms with no probabilities: a response common over a reading is what holds at every situation the reading leaves open, and a guard is kept against every admissible disturbance exactly under an invariant set. A true risk bound permits actual failure. Independent perception is the reviewers law. This read's join: the account calls none of it Knightian, and prescribes nothing.

says.en: Theorem (root; the requirement supplied and fixed before the outcome): the occurrences at which a given region holds throughout their closure form the largest region inside it closed under the relation, at a process's steps the invariance kernel. 07 §5: a response common over a reading exists within it exactly where the acts' kernels cover the situations.

For a law driven by admissible disturbances, given one, no history leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. The disturbances are supplied.

Theorem (any process; a supplied three-route process): a true one-third risk bound permits actual failure, and no judge reading only the mode-and-arrival projection classifies that bound for every realization of both event laws.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for a common response, and that a supplied set of disturbances or situations is still a model boundary.

source_adds.en: The distinction itself, uncertainty in the outcome set or model boundary as a named kind, and the discipline as a practice: limited irreversible authority, reversible trials, monitoring, appeal, repair. It stands in sources/06-zhishan/.

name.en: Traditions can negate the goal efficiency serves

source.locator: Claim 178; Open questions, writing program's audits

sense.en: 仁 changes where "I" begins, 义 keeps a judgment victory cannot confer, 礼 makes understanding repeatable, 智 discerns when displaying capability is not wise. They are neither decoration nor proof, and their value is that they can negate the goal efficiency serves, and refuse the project itself. The corpus reports it still functionalizes them.

entries.quote: they can negate the goal that efficiency serves

reading.en: The account keeps the room in method: agreement is not confirmation, a divergence does not show a text wrong, contrary readings are recorded, and a rival reading is told what it loses, not refuted. It does not let a tradition move its premises, and it reads texts for structure, so the folder's charge of functionalizing can be put to it as well. No tradition is spoken for here.

says.en: 相合不是印证 (agreement is not confirmation): the law does not rest on the text, and the law does not exhaust the text's meaning.
相分与反读：照录. Texts disagree about 续 itself and are not made to agree; 中观破相续 is kept with its open question.
Not shown: that a divergence, where a text asserts what the theory gives only under a condition, shows the text wrong (一处相分…表明原文错了); the theory asserts no ethical axiom.

[AI reading, D54] A competing reading ascribes authority of responsibility only to specific formed relations; under the condition that is a narrowing; the condition's ground is open, so the theory does not refute it and only says what it loses.

source_adds.en: Each virtue's content as what it forms, traditions' standing to refuse the project, and the worry about functionalizing as a named risk.

name.en: Moral insight needs a material bridge: preservation, reproduction, selector change

sense.en: Moral insight becomes counter-selection only through recognition, costly action, visible fidelity, credible expectation, common protection of restrainers, institutions and later formation. Three levels must not be conflated: dissent surviving, its forming successors and institutions, and its altering what receives high-leverage resources.

entries.quote: three levels must not be conflated

reading.en: This read's own join. A rule held by members passes only where taught within tenure, and no holder stays no holder. In the market model selection creates no absent practice. A selector's change has the form of a reading beyond the share, in time. The model keeps the steps apart in count only: holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation, so the source's bridge from recognition to costly action is not modelled.

says.en: Theorem (root; a family of models): taught by members, at s ≤ l or a quota of 0 no holder is left after s steps; no holder stays no holder under the whole net; the steady rule is held exactly where l < s, 1 ≤ q and the take fits the renewal. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them.
Theorem (periphery; a witness in the model's numbers): a share of none stays none: selection does not create an absent practice.
Theorem (counts): a reading turns the course only before the late reading would favour the shapers. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for a rule passing, on one minimal model, with no bridge to actual institutions.

source_adds.en: The seven-step bridge, and the three levels as a diagnostic.

name.en: 邪理 and the three forms of evil

sense.en: Evil often arrives as a partial structure impersonating a universal one: others will grab so I must grab first; markets price things so all value should be priced. It deletes boundary, time and the whole. Evil has three forms, defensive contraction under scarcity, pure optimization detached from the whole, and institutions manufacturing the desires that drive them.

entries.quote: a partial structure impersonating a universal one

reading.en: One case has a live form; the general claim only a likeness, by this read's join. 06's 定域 is a relation for reading texts, not a claim that partial structures impersonate universal ones, so that target is an analogy. The live case: "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is withholding with memory, which absorbs, with a law giving first as the exit. The account calls none of this evil: 善 and 恶 have no formal predicate, and it does not type evils.

says.en: 定域: the source states it universally and the spine gives where exactly it holds, correcting the universal form. Scope is not denial (定域不是否定).

Reading [AI reading, D48]: "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.
[AI reading, D1, D5] 善、恶、智 have no formal predicate.

source_adds.en: The three forms as a typology, and everything that repeatedly shapes attention named 教.

name.en: A configuration, not a law: so nobody may plead no alternative

sense.en: Runaway loops are set by liability rules, evaluation standards, procurement thresholds and deployment gates, all adjustable: therefore changeable, therefore nobody may plead no alternative. A system can produce selfish behaviour without selfish people, and domains couple with no sovereign.

entries.quote: Runaway loops are a *configuration, not a law*

reading.en: The first step has laws: a lock is left by a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection. Selfish behaviour without selfish people has one too: each within what a step gives, together more. The second step does not follow. Where the rest outruns the renewal a score from its end cannot tell a member's acts apart, past a point a window is closed, and an empty plan set generates no duty. So some pleas stand, on those models. And no guarantee.

says.en: Theorem (any type): where the reading favours at every share every course locks from its second reading step, so only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves.
Exits, each under stated hypotheses, several with the step at which the window closes. Not shown: that any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective.

Theorem (World; hypotheses listed): where the rest alone take more than a step gives, the condition ends whatever a member takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike, so no weight on such a reading selects its restraint.
Conditional: responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty; a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; it restates the tragedy of the commons in near-definitional arithmetic, not who ought to take less.

No guarantee, by the theory's own laws, each on its stated model; achievable under stated conditions only for named exits. The live answer to the folder's own unanswered question of how likely escape is: no probability is given.

account_adds.en: Where each exit's window closes, and what is left to a member where it cannot change the rest.

source_adds.en: Responsibility following from changeability, and regimes coupling with no sovereign as a claim about actual domains. Selfish behaviour without selfish people as a claim about actual systems; its form is a law here.

name.en: Load-bearing freeze against lock-in

source.locator: Terms: Load-bearing freeze; Open questions, nine-reviewer audit; claim 183

sense.en: Freezing at the base can open generation above it (grammar, protocol, foundation), as against freezing that devours the channels of correction and substitution. So "no form may become the final form" does not kill TCP/IP or the genetic code. Promises, law and education sacrifice shallow options for deep capability.

entries.quote: Freezing at the base that opens generation above it

reading.en: 06 maps the same split. Limits that enable constrain steps and leave what is constrained obtainable; limits that sever monopolize entry, and a limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be regained, not its name. Then it goes further: stability and frozen law-source are one structure read from two sides, so judgment enters only by comparison, under the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, and not by type. It is an AI reading mapping early terms, not a law on freezing.

says.en: [AI reading, D49] 成生之限 (promises, training, stopping harm) constrain some steps and what is constrained stays obtainable; 绝生之限 monopolize entry. 稳与元闭 are one structure, read from what the rule holds or from the change that would reach it: judgment differs and structure does not, which is why evaluation enters only through comparison.

account_adds.en: That stability and frozen rule cannot be told apart by structure.

source_adds.en: Named cases of a good freeze, and the use against the objection that no form may be final.

name.en: 善意不是载体: the generative recursion needs material carriers

sense.en: Goodwill is not the carrier; the carriers are time, resources, care, knowledge, maintenance, organization, legal standing, conflict handling and capture-resistance. The generative loop must be as materially specified as the closing one. Its direction: from the gun barrel to the substrate, raising the common floor.

entries.quote: 善意不是载体

reading.en: The same point on models: reciprocal promises can be empty, ignition needs a reserve already present, and selection must fund actual succession. Building shared capacity can be warranted only under the continuation condition and C with J1 to J4, and overbuilding that depletes the living basis is the counterexample. The account does not say where compute should flow.

says.en: Theorem (any process; periphery module): promises do not: "if the other eventually does, I eventually do" holds on both sides where neither ever happens; ignition needs a reserve already present.

Theorem (periphery): selection must fund actual succession. Under a certificate covering correction plus migration each generation takes its step; a safe aggregate can lack a carrier, and safety for correction alone need not cover migration. That a succession is warranted is not shown.
Conditional (the condition; C with J1–J4; correspondence): it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; it does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority.

account_adds.en: Exact cases where a circular dependence is a wait no one can begin.

source_adds.en: The seven steps of the generative loop and the positive content of redirection.

name.en: The chain of appearance: difference, information, 感, 像, 象

source.locator: Claim 225; Terms: Chain of appearance, Phenomenon / model

sense.en: Difference carries information; information enters 感 to become 像; 像 acted out becomes new 象, which becomes new difference. A model is borne by bodies, language, code and institutions, so the same borne structure is 像 toward what it represents and 象 toward the causality it enters.

entries.quote: Difference carries information; information enters 感 to become 像; 像 acted out becomes new 象, which becomes new difference

reading.en: The closed form agrees with the reading loop: a formation reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on. The account states six laws of that loop under premises and has no five-term chain; a search for 像 and 幻象 in 06 found another sense only. Same words are not same reference, and its 理 and 文 are defined otherwise.

says.en: A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on. Six laws state that loop under their premises.

account_adds.en: When a reading is kept by its own update, and when a prediction read by what it predicts is right.

source_adds.en: The five terms, 幻像 and 幻象, and a model's being itself a phenomenon as a stated claim.

name.en: Provenance: what is distilled from billions belongs to the commons

source.locator: From provenance, in the four derivations; claims 160 to 162; the reviews' finding on provenance

sense.en: What is distilled from the accumulated language of billions belongs categorically to the commons. Two reviewers broke it: commons origin does not entail commons ownership. v0.4 limits it to instruments at planetary scale; the later review weakens it to a public governance obligation for a gate everyone must pass, not ownership. The folder calls this its most load-bearing and most fragile wall.

entries.quote: The provenance argument is the most load-bearing and the most fragile wall.

reading.en: Not found, by word or mechanism. 'Commons' in the live account is a shared stock drawn down, another reference; 'ownership' is the crux's, of one's effects; 'provenance' is of text. Nothing says what forming from shared language gives anyone a claim to, or what a gate is owed. The nearest is 06's mapping of monopolized entry to a closure, with no verdict. Not a defect by itself.

source_adds.en: The claim, its scale bridge and its weakened form. It stands in sources/06-zhishan/ and this folder.

searched: commons, provenance, ownership, 公器, 汇亿众, planetary, 行星 in the chapters, front pages, review/ and GLOSSARY; the commons, provenance and ownership hits are other senses, read by grep lines

name.en: 自取灭亡: a directional judgment, not a catastrophe prediction

sense.en: 自取 needs no unified civilizational will, only many locally intelligible actions jointly raising the gain of a loop that consumes its own conditions. 灭亡 includes substrate collapse, lock-in where all effective action must pass one path, and a society full of activity unable to judge what is worth continuing. The programme's verdict on the present direction.

entries.quote: is a directional, recursive judgment, not a catastrophe prediction

reading.en: The mechanism has laws on models: each within what a step gives while together more, ending every formation depending at the need, with no will; a whole drawing past renewal ends; closed capture for lock-in. But the account declines 自取 as such: the whole's law does not show that the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss, and a drain is no harm without the continuation condition and C. Calibration to the present is not established.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, the gate local): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; n such steps from a level below n + m end every formation depending at need at least m.

Theorem (World; hypotheses listed): a whole whose parts arise only where they then depend on a family, its renewal gated, has no part arising after n steps of uptake past replenishment from a stock below n + m, and ends. It does not show that the collective is the consumer, or that its ending is a loss.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: calibration to the present world is not established.

account_adds.en: That taking by a part can be within what a step gives, so the ending is not read off any member.

source_adds.en: The judgment on the present course, and 灭亡 as a society still active but unable to judge; 'the gain of a loop' as the variable.

name.en: Variety, so that systems do not all die alike

sense.en: No system can be guaranteed against collapse, so the real invariant is keeping the sample space open: a variety of systems so that they do not all die from the same situational influence, foreseeable or not. Death is a feature; the aim is a rich space of systems, not one rule or attractor.

entries.quote: so that they do not all die from the same situational influence

reading.en: Correlated failure has checked forms, on narrower objects. Reviewers moved under one cause fail together with all names kept, and a cause in no bound fails every reviewer, which is the source's 'foreseeable or not'. Copies add nothing. An ending reaches only what depends on the condition at the need, so unlike dependence escapes it. This read's join from reviewers to systems. No law ranks variety: that needs C, with scope from the continuation condition.

says.en: Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied): moving two reviewers under one cause makes readiness fail while all names are kept; a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer.
Theorem (no axiom; witnesses on a finite roster): a witness copying one on the roster gives the same certificate at every pool of faults. That a witness merely agreeing adds nothing is not shown.
The ending reaches every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m; a taker not so depending can continue.

source_adds.en: Variety of systems as the real invariant, death as a feature, and keeping the space open forbidding its optimization.
